block_readings.visual_reading: Reef and a constructed island occur in the southern frame, but no centre is securely on the constructed island body. The exact pale/blue reef and shoal centres listed as unresolved need exposure evidence; six centres are visibly seaward in continuous dark water.

Centres skirt northwest/west of a small reef/island, and a southwest group lies in dark sea. Seven centres encounter the coloured reef margin; remaining centres show continuous sea-surface appearance, including the visibly waterward outer skirt. The visible island body has no assigned centre.
All marked centres lie in continuous dark wave-textured sea; no island or opaque cloud occurs at the centres.

Scattered cloud/shadow and a reef with construction occur south/west of the marked points. Every marked centre is on unobscured wave-textured water in the upper/right portion; the nearby cloud and structure are not used as a claim about a centre.
The eastern partial frame includes cloud/shadows and reef at the bottom; marked upper and middle centres lie in uninterrupted visible water away from them.

Western centres run through lagoon/reef context while the eastern centres lie in dark open water. Twelve centres at the pale/variegated southwest reef margin remain exposure questions; blue lagoon and seaward centres show dated water appearance without land structure.
Point7020 is visibly just seaward of the reef in dark sea. Points7021–7026 encounter the pale shallow reef edge with no secure exposed terrestrial body at the exact centre.
Centres cross the southern reef margin. Points7027–7030 and7041–7042 encounter coloured reef/mixed shallow margins;7031–7040 are visibly waterward in dark continuous sea.

A distinct constructed island lies northwest of the marked group. All165 original centres lie south of it in dark continuous water. Small cloud/shadow features occur farther east, away from this group.
All19 centres lie in dark continuous wave-textured sea; the small cloud/shadow pair west of the southern centres does not cover them.
All12 centres in the southern partial frame lie in continuous wave-textured dark sea.
